# Synthetic workflow

This specification operates on an in-memory demonstration workspace.
The supplied context, catalog and goal describe its complete inputs.

```tsg-workflow
{
  "version": 1,
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "s001",
      "kind": "effect",
      "op": "write",
      "resource": "/demo/cleanup0/report",
      "value": "clean",
      "key": "report"
    },
    {
      "id": "s002",
      "kind": "effect",
      "op": "delete",
      "resource": "/demo/cleanup0/old",
      "key": "remove"
    },
    {
      "id": "s003",
      "kind": "effect",
      "op": "emit",
      "resource": "/demo/cleanup0/audit",
      "value": "clean",
      "key": "audit"
    }
  ],
  "functions": {}
}
```
